one_liner: Sprinto automates compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and more) for cloud companies.

capabilities.text: connects to cloud, HR and code tools and collects audit evidence automatically
monitors controls continuously and flags drift before the auditor does
maps one set of controls across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA so work isn't repeated
gets teams audit-ready without hiring a dedicated compliance team first
keeps a trust centre and answers to security questionnaires current for enterprise deals
ships policy templates and tracks employee security training and device checks
